description: A Dart model class representing a user entity within the application, including serialization and copy mechanisms.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Model class representing a user with fields like id, email, name, contact info, timestamps, and methods for JSON serialization and copying.

methods.name: User.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a User instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: User.toJson
methods.description: Converts the User instance into a JSON map.

methods.name: User.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the User instance, optionally overriding specific fields.
